name: adaptive-cycle-mapping
title: Adaptive Cycle Mapping
description: The four phases of the adaptive cycle from panarchy theory (Gunderson and Holling, 2002), plus an exit from the cycle. Use it to mark where a system, product or organization sits in its cycle of growth, conservation, release and reorganization.

classes.name: Growth or Exploitation (Γ)
classes.note: A phase of the adaptive cycle. A phase describes the state of a system, not a cause or an effect, so the logical kind is not decided yet.

classes.name: Conservation (Κ)
classes.note: A phase of the adaptive cycle. A phase describes the state of a system, not a cause or an effect, so the logical kind is not decided yet.
